vocab.definition_en: artificial intelligence that surpasses human intelligence across all domains
vocab.definition_zh: 在所有领域都超越人类智能的人工智能
vocab.example_en: Coding agents will be the foundation of all superintelligence.
vocab.example_zh: 编码智能体将成为所有超级智能的基础。

vocab.definition_en: a high degree of competence or skill in doing something
vocab.definition_zh: 在某事中具有高度的能力或技巧
vocab.example_en: Coding ability is indistinguishable from proficiency with computers.
vocab.example_zh: 编码能力与计算机操作熟练程度是等同的。

vocab.definition_en: the quality of being able to express oneself readily and effortlessly; smooth and natural ability
vocab.definition_zh: 能够轻松自然地表达和执行某事的质量
vocab.example_en: Coding fluency has given models a deeper understanding of all computer work.
vocab.example_zh: 编码流畅性使模型对所有计算机工作有了更深的理解。

vocab.definition_en: using one's own product to test and improve it before releasing to customers
vocab.definition_zh: 使用自己的产品来测试和改进，然后再发布给客户
vocab.example_en: The team is dogfooding the new fitness app to identify bugs.
vocab.example_zh: 团队正在使用自己的健身应用来识别漏洞。

vocab.definition_en: the process of change or alteration, especially in code or genetic material; self-modification
vocab.definition_zh: 变化或改变的过程，特别是代码或遗传物质的自我修改
vocab.example_en: A coding agent can mutate itself directly to improve its capabilities.
vocab.example_zh: 编码智能体可以直接改变自己以提高其能力。

vocab.definition_en: the tendency to dismiss expert knowledge in fields outside one's own expertise while accepting less rigorous information
vocab.definition_zh: 倾向于忽视自己专业领域外的专家知识，同时接受不太严谨的信息的现象
vocab.example_en: Gell-Mann amnesia explains why people underestimate AI's limitations in jobs they don't do.
vocab.example_zh: 盖尔曼遗忘症解释了为什么人们在自己不做的工作中低估了AI的局限性。

vocab.definition_en: a record of all changes, actions, or transactions for accountability and monitoring purposes
vocab.definition_zh: 用于问责和监控的所有更改、操作或交易的记录
vocab.example_en: AI self-modifications should include an audit trail for human review.
vocab.example_zh: AI自我修改应包括用于人类审查的审计跟踪。

vocab.definition_en: a subtle difference or distinction in meaning, expression, or appearance
vocab.definition_zh: 意义、表达或外观中微妙的差异或区别
vocab.example_en: People appreciate the nuances of their own work but overlook them in others' jobs.
vocab.example_zh: 人们欣赏自己工作的微妙之处，但忽视了他人工作中的微妙之处。
